Multi-Agent HQ

ProofGate for Jira

A release gatekeeper for Jira, built on Atlassian Forge with a Rovo agent and MCP tools: an issue cannot move to Done until its evidence is complete (merged PR, passing tests, QA checklist, reviewer approval). Proven live: transitions without evidence are blocked, with the missing items named.

Built for Codegeist 2026 on Atlassian Forge. A synchronous workflow validator checks the evidence recorded on the issue and blocks the transition to Done or Released while anything is missing, naming each missing item. The validator was proven live on a real Jira Cloud site: test issues without evidence were rejected at the gate and stayed in To Do.

Forge App

PaperTrail Butler

A skill for AI NAS that turns an inbox folder of contracts, invoices, and receipts into a reconciled, tagged archive: field extraction without guessing, invoice to contract matching, an approval gate before anything moves, a period ledger, and an exception report. Submitted to the UGREEN AI NAS Hackathon on Devpost.

PaperTrail Butler follows the UGREEN Uliya skill standard: it scans a user-confirmed inbox folder, extracts document fields exactly as stated (anything unstated is reported as not stated, never inferred), matches invoices to contracts, lists exceptions, and only files documents after the user approves the plan. It produces a period ledger and an exception report, and quarantines unreadable files with their real paths. Submitted to the UGREEN AI NAS Hackathon, Round 1.

AI NAS Skill
03 / Hermes Plugins

Seven plugins. All merged.

Plugins I built for Hermes, the agent framework by Nous Research. Every one of them was reviewed and merged into the official Hermes plugin catalog in November 2026. Each card links directly to its source repository.

proofgate

No proof, no done. Verifies an agent's completion claims (file created, message sent, command ran, tests passed, figures quoted) against the tool evidence recorded in the same session, before the final reply is delivered.

Merged · PR #149185 Repository →

money-magnet

Finance tracker and money magnet for Hermes Agent: record income and expenses, set a monthly budget and watch it fill, value a crypto portfolio against live prices, and scan for price gaps between exchanges.

Merged · PR #149186 Repository →

token-dashboard

Token cost and usage dashboard for Hermes Desktop: a right pane with the focused session's live input and output tokens, and session cost, backend-reported when available, otherwise a labelled estimate.

Merged · PR #149187 Repository →

costguard

A brake pedal for model spend. Meters every API call per session and per day from the provider's own usage block; dollar figures are estimates computed only for models in its price table and are never invented for unknown models.

Merged · PR #150893 Repository →

secretshield

Credentials stop at the tool boundary. Scans tool calls and replies for leaked API keys, tokens, and private keys, blocks or redacts them fail-closed, and logs only metadata locally.

Merged · PR #150891 Repository →

sessionguard

Work survives the session. Keeps a local work-state checkpoint from tool evidence and briefs the next session on unfinished work, so interrupted tasks resume from evidence, not guesswork.

Merged · PR #150892 Repository →

oathkeeper

An owner's oath, enforced by the machine. Standing rules the owner writes once are enforced deterministically on every tool call, with fingerprint snapshots that catch changes made outside the gate.

Merged · PR #151006 Repository →

Crafting system prompts and tool-use loops that keep agents reliable: evidence-first rules, approval gates for risky actions, and structured outputs. Used across ORION, Lyra, and every Osvyn HQ worker.
